description: Zone d'aléa du Plan de Prévention des Risques d'Inondation (PPRI) du département du Doubs is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.ideobfc.fr. The data are derived from the hazard study, which aims to assess the intensity of the hazard at any point in the study area. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Risk zone of the Flood Risk Prevention Plan (PPRI) of the department of Doubs" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include risque, crue, inondation, Hydrographie, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2016-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
